title.narrative: SUPPORT CONTINUATION AND CONSOLIDATION OF MNCH PREVIOUS PROGRAMME; TACKLE ACUTE MALNUTRION - NUTRITION COMPONENT AND REDUCTION OF ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT

description.narrative: This grant to Clinton Health Access Initiative (CHAI) aims to support implementation of year two of the Protecting the Future: Health and Resilience Program 2022-2025.The program acts across three results areas. The first results area represents the continuation and consolidation of CHAI’s on-going MNCH work in Mozambique and focuses on improving diagnosis and treatment for the top MNCH disease conditions in country, particularly pre-eclampsia, neonatal illnesses including malaria and pneumonia, paediatric cancer, cleft lip, and malnutrition. To complement/activities developed under MNCH, CHAI has introduced a nutrition component to tackle acute malnutrition, mild malnutrition and, rehabilitation program.The remaining two results areas are also new fields of action for the Ireland-CHAI partnership and focus on reducing the environmental impact of healthcare waste and on improving the safety and availability of routine and Covid-19 vaccines. The latter focus area builds upon CHAI’s critical support to Government over the pandemic, specifically cold chain provision and maintenance for Covid-19 vaccines.
